title: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 10.6 Introduction to Factoring Polynomials: Find the greatest common factor of two or more expressions
summary: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 10.6 Introduction to Factoring Polynomials: Find the greatest common factor of two or more expressions
body: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, section "10.6 Introduction to Factoring Polynomials", prints these objectives: "Find the greatest common factor of two or more expressions" "Factor the greatest common factor from a polynomial". The section text says: "Earlier we multiplied factors together to get a product. Now, we will be reversing this process; we will start with a product and then break it down into its factors. Splitting a product into factors is called factoring." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
